result.summary: The page overall looks well-structured with minor styling inconsistency found in the heart/favorite icon contrast on the ramen bar card.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white outline on a dark but busy food image background, making it slightly harder to see compared to the same icon on the pizza card below which has a solid dark circle background for contrast.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent semi-transparent dark circle background behind the heart icon on all promotional cards for better visibility and consistency.
